notes.title: To the Grave - live stream with devs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182041/2a23dc1ee0e403aab4138eded1bcf0bf0ffb6987.png[/img]

This game is not only scary, but also very [b]FUNNY[/b]. 

Hello, everyone! Welcome to my live stream of To the Grave, a 2D horror adventure puzzle game with oriental elements. In this game, you play as a girl who woke up from a car accident and forgot everything. She accidentally entered a mysterious village, where strange things are happening. You have to solve puzzles, explore the dark forest, the deserted village, the mansion full of secrets, and more. This game is not only scary, but also very funny. You will laugh at some of the situations and dialogues. Trust me, you don’t want to miss this game. So join me and let’s have some fun together!
